t: Where to look when you do not know how to act
a: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا
p: Laqad kāna lakum fī rasūli-llāhi uswatun ḥasanatun li-man kāna yarju-llāha wa-l-yawma-l-ākhira wa dhakara-llāha kathīrā.
m: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
